note: any_molecular_selection false: the Cohort 1 MGMT-unmethylated criterion has an alternative route for methylated/indeterminate patients unable to take TMZ (D31-A2), and the IDH-mutant exclusions are CNS5-defining (D31-A5). Ketogenic diet is an excluded intervention type, not an agent. Nothing pending for XL.

revisions.reason: Cohort 1 requires unmethylated MGMT but also admits "subjects with methylated or indeterminate MGMT status that are unwilling, or otherwise unable, to undergo treatment with temozolomide", so MGMT is one optional route (D31-A2); the IDH-mutant exclusions only define CNS5 glioblastoma (D31-A5) and Cohort 2 accepts any MGMT status.
